description: Build a Strict-Transport-Security response-header value from a max-age (in seconds) plus optional includeSubDomains and preload directives, flagging combinations that will not qualify for browser HSTS preload lists (which require max-age >= 1 year, includeSubDomains, and preload all together).

includeSubDomains.description: Whether the policy also applies to all subdomains, default false

maxAge.description: How long, in seconds, the browser should remember this host is HTTPS-only, e.g. 31536000 for 1 year

preload.description: Whether to opt into browser HSTS preload lists, default false

name: build_hsts_header
